_readme: Per-chapter content for the B workspace. Everything is optional: with no entries a student writes their own example reflections and concept cards. Shape: { "<courseId>": { "<chapter>": { "examples": [ { "key": "1E1", "label": "Example 1", "prompt": "problem statement (plain text or $TeX$)" } ], "concepts": [ { "key": "1K1", "name": "Domain and range", "prompt": "Explain in your own words, and say when you would use it." } ] } } }. Keys must be unique within a chapter and must never be reused for a different item (student answers are saved against them).
